horoscope: With the Moon at the top of your solar chart continuing today, dear Aries, you are more likely to be in the spotlight, noticed, and perhaps quite in demand. You’re in a goal-oriented frame of mind, but you could wrestle with conflicting needs and approaches. Rethink your strategies but don’t over-analyze emotions just for now. Fortunately, as the day advances, there's good energy for a resolution to a problem related to debt, support, or shared resources. Agreement comes relatively easily, especially with a "soft sell" approach. Love can deepen with a partner by sharing something personal and intimate. Hearts are open right now.

The Moon continues its transit of your sector of spirit and adventure today, dear Taurus, inspiring an attitude that there’s something more to enjoy, learn, or explore. Still, transits today tend to highlight different drives, needs, and approaches, leading to a bit of indecision. You may feel divided, with one part of you focused on practical problems and another more socially oriented. However, especially as the day advances, this can be a good time to communicate your feelings for someone. You're in a good position to come together in agreement or cooperation with a partner or special friend. Because you are uniquely receptive to what others are saying, and you're tuned into what you feel they may be thinking, this is a great time for negotiations, particularly on a one-to-one level, or with a partner. You are gracious and accepting, and others return the favor.

You can be particularly interested in activities that heal, renew, and refresh today, dear Gemini, and your helpfulness, service, or work is likely to be appreciated. You’re especially interested in the many different layers of situations, people, and your own emotions today. A feeling of being “on the fence” is likely, but waiting to make a decision is a good idea. As the day advances, people may be seeing and appreciating your unique vision, catching on to your excitement. While you're socially focused, you can be quite productive on your own. Let intuition work for you.

You benefit from seeing your life from a different angle or perspective today, dear Cancer. The day seems to draw more attention to the contrasts in your life, including your varied needs and approaches across different life departments. There can be some see-sawing, with decisions rather hard to come by temporarily. However, as the day advances, your appeal gets a real boost, particularly when it comes to your creative ideas, wit, and warmth. This is a potentially excellent time for all things romantic and creative. Friendships can be exceptionally warm, and love affairs particularly friendly. This can be a time for seeking out pleasure and sharing good times with others, and also for putting regrets or resentments behind you.

The Moon again spends the day in your work and health sector, dear Leo, and you’re focused on making sense of things or fixing problems. Today’s transits tend to highlight the contrasts in your life. You have a strong desire to settle in and focus, but your curiosity is big. Especially as the day advances, you are particularly open to sharing your time and energy with loved ones. You might feel a pleasing sense of belonging and understanding with someone close to you. You may decide to reveal something personal about yourself. Try not to push for answers, but do some gentle exploration now, and aim to get in touch with your intuition.

Creative and interesting pursuits continue to hold a special draw today, dear Virgo. Your emotional focus stays on personal enjoyment, self-expression, and pleasure. Part of you only wants to simplify and pull back, but another part is intensely curious these days, which can distract you. It can be challenging to recognize which activities serve you well and which ones subtract from your fun, but it’s useful to try. As the day advances, sharing your ideas can be especially gratifying, and you can be excited about a project, idea, or venture. Clearing the air with someone can lead to good feelings. Conversations tend to be more considerate than usual, holding the potential to mend and heal.

The Moon continues its transit of your home and family sector all day, dear Libra, and you remain a little self-protective and withdrawn. Nevertheless, the day tends to highlight our differences or problems, requiring some adjustments. You can be indecisive as you wrestle with conflicting needs and approaches. Take the time for self-understanding. You can benefit greatly from centering yourself first and foremost. Especially as the day advances, it's a strong time for healing yourself through grounding activities or physical contact. It's a favorable time to negotiate contracts or bargains, and perhaps make a nice purchase.

While the day’s not ideal for decisiveness, dear Scorpio, you might pick up a nice variety of useful information. The Moon moves through your communications sector again today, and you’re quick to respond or connect. The day highlights contrasts, and you become more aware of your different drives, needs, and approaches as a result. As the day progresses, energies point to benefits from collaboration or learning about your ideas and perspective through stimulating conversations. It's an excellent time to talk through difficulties or put conflicts behind you. Someone might give you the benefit of the doubt. Creative ideas and shows of affection can stand out as notable.

The Moon continues its transit of your resources sector all day, dear Sagittarius, and you seek a comfortable pace and emotional balance. Special attention to practical affairs can go a long way towards improved well-being. Keep things simple for best results, and find ways to reduce stress. If you can, leave the tougher decision-making for a time when you’re more confident and aware of what you truly want. Especially as the day advances, hopefulness and optimism come in handy, and you might spot a new opportunity to grow or expand a pursuit. Energies are good for seeking ways to heal, both emotionally and physically, through activities that feed the mind, body, and spirit. You're inclined to quickly find answers to questions and solutions to problems as you zoom out and let your intuition work for you.

The Moon continues to spend time in your sign today, dear Capricorn. You’re attracted to something a little different or non-routine today. Because there can be small disappointments and energy levels can dip temporarily, try not to take on too much. It may be best to avoid committing or limiting yourself. Still, as the day advances, connecting with someone or putting bad feelings about a past relationship behind you can be in order. This can be a positive time for friendships, particularly when it comes to sharing ideas and exchanging stories, and for networking.  You can be quite popular with a partner, friends, and/or associates now, and you may receive favors or simply enjoy good company. Someone may be expressing their feelings about you.

The day’s energies are better for winding down, dear Aquarius. There's some tendency to feel divided since you’re both socially and practically inclined today. If you can spend extra time free of interference so that you can do your own thing, you’ll benefit greatly. As the day advances, you're in good shape for coming up with long-ranging plans, although the details may not be well accounted for quite yet. Work and health matters can benefit from a brainstorming session. You could find a nice balance between your personal and professional life now. You're feeling good about your performance, and this fires you up for creating new goals in these areas.

Transits today may seem to highlight needs that are at odds, dear Pisces. Part of you wants to move on, but a more protective, contemplative side feels equally strong. This can lead to small misunderstandings, but it can also prompt you to assess what may be standing in the way of joy, growth, and improvement. As the day advances, energies are strong for insight, planning, and enjoying an increase in motivation. Children, a romantic partner, or a friend can be incredibly considerate or encouraging now. It can be a time for self-improvement by extending yourself beyond your regular routine. As well, the information you share with someone may even be healing.
